Name: CP - SH's Cuter Pepper Rex
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: This mod replaces the default Pepper Rex sprite to match IdentityPollution's Cuter Fatter Dinos mod.
Description:
I personally liked using [IdentityPollution's Cuter Fatter Dinos](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3620)﻿ (very cute! highly recommended!) I noticed the Pepper Rexes that were added in the new update have a chance of having dino eggs with them. I decided to turn the Pepper Rex into a bigger version of the cuter dinos mod to make them match (so it's like this is the fully grown version of the cuter dinos mod﻿)! I just got my screen tab and this was a good exercise (´ ∀ ` *)

Credits to IdentityPollution for the original design and if they want this mod to be taken down, then feel free to inform me  (⌒ω⌒)ﾉ
